# Testing (server)

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs` from the code. Edit the code comments, not this file. -->

Control tests (with preparers and reviewers) and evidence (fingerprinted with SHA-256).

## Files

- `evidence-routes.ts`: Evidence: list, upload, verify the hash and download.
- `test-records.ts`: Turns control test and evidence rows into API records.
- `test-routes.ts`: Control tests: list, add, prepare and review (segregation of duties applies).

## Routes

Full detail, with request fields, in [`docs/API.md`](../../../../docs/API.md).

| Method | Path | Permission | Body |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/engagements/:id/tests` | read |  |
| POST | `/api/engagements/:id/tests` | prepare | `TestInput` |
| PATCH | `/api/tests/:id` | prepare | `(inline schema)` |
| POST | `/api/tests/:id/review` | approve | `(inline schema)` |
| GET | `/api/engagements/:id/evidence` | read |  |
| GET | `/api/evidence/:id/verify` | read |  |
| GET | `/api/evidence/:id/download` | read |  |
